_comment: Copy to admob.json and fill in the real IDs. That file is gitignored:
section 8 requires production ad unit IDs to be supplied at build time and
never committed, and CI fails if one appears in lib/ or android/.
The App ID needs its own flag because it lives in AndroidManifest.xml as a
Gradle manifest placeholder, which a Dart define cannot reach.
The values below are Google's official test units. They show a test ad on
any device and can never earn or spend real money, so a build that forgets
the file is obviously wrong rather than silently broken.
